node.title: SOV affine-piece partition certificate soundness
node.statement: If a certificate partitions every forced-root conditioning cell into disjoint affine pieces where c(L)=[X^{h-1}]L has nonzero linear part, plus paid/norm-structured exceptional pieces whose total size is below the declared character-sum budget, then sov_hminus1_affine_piece_decomposition holds.
node.attack_surface: finite partition and affine-linear certificate semantics for SOV conditioned cells
node.falsifier: a verified affine/exceptional partition certificate that fails to imply the SOV h-1 affine-piece decomposition
